FN-GX5I2C6-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 86
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns, and Sponsor: Representative Chris Pringle
Elections
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 86 as introduced could increase election expenses, paid from the State General Fund
or local funds, by a small, undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to develop, print, and
deliver certain forms for use at polling places on election day, as provided by this bill.
